what: iOS 27 UISearchController (bottom toolbar placement) and UISearchTab touches on the device
probe: tool/ios_reference scene x3search (Sources/Extras.swift, X3Sampler) driven by UITests/ExtrasUITests.swift testX3Device (synthesized touches)
rows: start; touch; evt (script actions, willPresentSearch / didPresentSearch / willDismissSearch / didDismissSearch); V cls GlassInteractionView = the search field's / close button's glass (center x, y, size w, h, bounds bw, bh, ea effective alpha); V cls keyboard = UIKeyboardItemContainerView (y, h); V cls field = UIKit._UITabHostedSearchContainer

files.search-tap.jsonl: a tap on the resting field (the focus waits for the keyboard), then a tap on the close button
files.search-hold.jsonl: a 0.5 s press on the resting field (the glass lift)
files.tab-search-focus.jsonl: a UISearchTab with automaticallyActivatesSearch: a tap on the search circle (the tab -> field morph itself is SwiftUI glass, invisible in views), the focus rise above the keyboard, a tap on the close button
files.vid-tab.jsonl: (2026-10-03 screen-recording session, testX3Video) UISearchTab with automaticallyActivatesSearch: a tap on the search circle, typing, a tap on the close button (the field falls straight from above the keyboard to its place as the keyboard leaves), a tap on the tab circle, a second tap on the search circle; V cls UISearchBarTextField (the text field inside the capsule: x, y, w, h) and _UIRemoteKeyboardPlaceholderView (keyboard y, h)

units: points (pt), window coordinates, seconds on the device media clock
